content: {"reasoning":"The claim is denied CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable), and a plain correct_and_resubmit already failed twice with the same code, so resubmitting again risks a CO-18 duplicate denial. Authorization is not required and retro-auth isn't offered, so those paths are irrelevant. A denial is on the table, and the proper way to dispute a bundling determination is a formal appeal arguing the service was distinct/separately payable, supported by documentation.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
